text: So, this is me doing one of the two things that really worked, helping me get to the
point where I've actually finished my book, and that is getting up, it's London, it's
just after seven o'clock, I think, and on the days when I can, I don't do it every
day, but on the days when I can, I get up, I walk to a particular cafe, and I write.
So this is one of the things that I do that helped me actually finish my book, but there
are just a couple of other things that, if I hadn't done them as well, I don't think
I would have actually managed to write and finish my book, and that's what we talk about
in this course that we're running in January, on January the 6th, me and my friend Professor
Richard Toy, who's written 20 books, more than 20 books, so we tell you how to write
a book, and the name of the course is You Can Write A Book.
